answers.reply:
I wrote no document for the Sensors map. An Autark map draws only tables with geometry, and Air sensors returns a plain DataFrame with no geometry column, so there is nothing to draw: the node says "input_0 has no geometry column, so there is nothing to draw. Return a GeoDataFrame."

The fix is in the Air sensors node: it should return a GeoDataFrame with its active geometry set, points built from LONGITUDE and LATITUDE, such as gpd.GeoDataFrame(frame, geometry=[Point(xy) for xy in zip(frame['LONGITUDE'], frame['LATITUDE'])], crs=4326). A change to the Air sensors node can do that; the Sensors map then has a layer to draw.
